video:video.video:title: Venezuela surfers hold paddle-out memorial for victims of devastating earthquakes
video:video.video:description: Members of Venezuela's surfing community returned to the water Saturday for the first time in more than a month after devastating earthquakes struck the country's northern coast.

video:video.video:title: At least three killed, 15 wounded in Moscow restaurant explosion
video:video.video:description: At least three people were killed in an explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow, Russian state media said Saturday, citing local officials.

video:video.video:title: 'One bang, then another' - resident recounts moment of Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv
video:video.video:description: Russia launched an intense barrage of ballistic missiles and drones overnight into Saturday, killing at least nine people and wounding 30 civilians in the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv authorities said.

video:video.video:title: Three people killed, at least 21 wounded in Moscow restaurant bombing, Russian officials say
video:video.video:description: An improvised explosive device detonated at a restaurant Saturday in central Moscow killing at least three people, including the bomber, Russian state media said, citing local officials.

video:video.video:title: Costumed runners race to raise funds to support kids in foster care in Kansas
video:video.video:description: The inaugural Totally Awesome CASA Costume 5K took place in Lawrence, Kansas on Saturday to raise funds to support kids in foster care. (AP video by Nick Ingram)

video:video.video:title: Firefighters tackle flare-ups as aid reaches wildfire victims in Gironde
video:video.video:description: Firefighters in France's Gironde region stayed on high alert Friday, and continued to extinguish flare-ups while residents and volunteers supported emergency crews and families affected by the fire.

video:video.video:title: Danube records historic low in Croatia due to heat and drought
video:video.video:description: The Danube River, which runs through 10 countries from southwestern Germany to the Black Sea, has receded to never-before-seen lows along much of its course.

video:video.video:title: Residents left reeling after Russian attack hits Kryvyi Rih area, killing family of ten
video:video.video:description: A Russian ballistic missile killed a family of 10 when it struck their home on the outskirts of Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, on Thursday.

video:video.video:title: Moroccans who crossed into Ceuta explain why they attempted to reach the Spanish territory
video:video.video:description: Moroccans who crossed into Ceuta explain why they attempted to reach the Spanish territory

video:video.video:title: AP top stories July 31
video:video.video:description: Here's the latest for Saturday, July 31st: Strong winds fuel a major wildfire in Greece; Spain installs sea barrier on Ceuta's border; Palestinians in Gaza evacuate displacement camps amidst Israeli air strikes; Top dogs ride waves at annual World Dog Surfing Championships

video:video.video:title: Resident captures video of rockfall as earthquake hits volcanic area near Naples, Italy
video:video.video:description: A 4.7 earthquake hit a volcanic area near Naples, in Southern Italy, on Friday. The quake left 26 people injured, the national Civil Protection agency said on Saturday.

video:video.video:title: Multiple people dead after shooting at fast food restaurant in southern Idaho
video:video.video:description: A shooting at an In-N-Out Burger restaurant in southern Idaho on Saturday afternoon left multiple people dead and others injured, police said.

video:video.video:title: Fishing closures are becoming routine as record heat warms rivers in the US West
video:video.video:description: Trout need cool water to survive, but record heat this summer has driven water temperatures to levels that can be lethal to the fish.

video:video.video:title: Displaced Palestinians in central Gaza jolted awake by evacuation warnings as Israeli strikes follow
video:video.video:description: An Israeli air strike targeted and destroyed two out of four medicine storage facilities in a hospital in Deir al-Balah, according to the region's Health Ministry.

video:video.video:title: Hungary braces for a full shutdown of the Paks nuclear plant as the Danube hits record lows
video:video.video:description: Hungary's only nuclear power plant is shutting down for the first time due to record-low water levels on the Danube River.

video:video.video:title: Reaction in Gaza as Trump announces deal for Hamas to disarm
video:video.video:description: Some Palestinians expressed scant hope on Friday after U.S. President Donald Trump announced that a deal has been reached for the militant group Hamas to disarm and for Israel to withdraw its forces in Gaza.

video:video.video:title: Century-old Japanese inn faces uncertain future after it was damaged in earthquake
video:video.video:description: In southern Yatsushiro City, another hard-hit area by the recent earthquake in southern Kumamoto, Kinparo, a 116-year old Japanese inn, was severely damaged.

video:video.video:title: Small plane carrying foreign tourists crashes in southern Peru, killing 13
video:video.video:description: A small plane carrying foreign tourists crashed Saturday near the city of Nazca in southern Peru, killing 13 people, authorities said.

video:video.video:title: Why is the Spanish territory of Ceuta a flashpoint for migration from Africa?
video:video.video:description: Between 50,000 and 60,000 migrants breached the frontier from Morocco to the Spanish territory earlier this week.

video:video.video:title: Resident returns to burnt remains of home destroyed in France wildfires
video:video.video:description: On Thursday, July 23, Matthieu Plessis drove through the French town of Le Porge, as flames raced along both sides of the road.

video:video.video:title: Cellphone captures people running away from In-N-Out shooting
video:video.video:description: Cellphone footage captures people running away from an In-N-Out restaurant in Twin Falls, Idaho, during a shooting.

video:video.video:title: UEFA declares no confidence in FIFA President over failed World Cup equity plan
video:video.video:description: Gianni Infantino had proposed creating a $20 billion company to run the World Cup with private investors, but drew backlash that grew every day since Tuesday’s announcement.

video:video.video:title: Surf's Pup! Canine competitors ride to glory at Dog Surfing Championship
video:video.video:description: The 10th Annual Dog Surfing Championship in Pacifica, California, drew crowds as dogs of all sizes competed in the waves alongside their human handlers.

video:video.video:title: Russia hits Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles and drones, killing at least 9
video:video.video:description: At least nine people were killed and 22 civilians injured in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv after Russia launched an intense barrage of ballistic missiles and drones overnight into Saturday, authorities said.

video:video.video:title: Volunteers from Greek NGO rush to save animals from a raging wildfire in Porto Germeno
video:video.video:description: Volunteers from Greek nongovernmental organization, Dog's Voice, rushed to save animals from a raging wildfire in Porto Germeno, a popular resort on the Gulf of Corinth.

video:video.video:title: Strong winds fuel a major wildfire burning in a seaside area on the Greek mainland
video:video.video:description: Gale-force winds whipped up the flames of a major wildfire burning out of control in a seaside area on the Greek mainland Saturday, hampering efforts to bring under control the blaze that broke out the previous day and led authorities to evacuate more than 250 people by sea on Friday.
